A1.justification: Both PDFs describe ShifCon and contain readable methods, equations, experiments, figures, tables, and appendices. Relocated and renumbered material can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v5 reports original multilingual benchmark results, representation analyses, and ablations, including Tables 1–4 and appendix experiments on pooling and training stages.

after.justification: v6 retains those original results and adds Llama-3 8B evaluations and a language-vector strategy ablation.

M1.justification: The shift projections, distance-based layer selection, MCL objective, two-stage training, and weighted language-vector update are retained. The strategy separately headed in v6 Appendix A.6 already appears in v5 Appendix A.4; naming and pooling-description edits do not establish a changed proposed procedure.

E1.justification: Both use MGSM8KInstruct and Bactrian-X for training and MGSM, FLORES, XCOPA, XNLI, and XStoryCloze for evaluation. The language subsets and translation directions match. The added model evaluation and ablation reuse this coverage.

E2.justification: English-only fine-tuning, MSFT, and AFP remain the main comparators. v6 Table 10 adds straightforward mean pooling as a comparator for language-vector estimation, distinct from the retained sentence-pooling comparison formerly in v5 Table 9.

E3.justification: v6 adds a Llama-3 8B configuration to the three-task classification comparison and a controlled comparison of language-vector strategies on XGLM564M. Existing evaluation metrics, prompting, training settings, and two-stage procedure are retained.

E4.justification: v6 Appendix A.6/Table 10 adds an ablation testing whether the existing weighted language-vector strategy outperforms straightforward mean pooling. The earlier pooling, training-stage, component, language-consistency, and layer-selection analyses remain; moving the pooling study does not constitute another new analysis.

E5.justification: Both implementation appendices state that results average three random-seed runs. The figures retain the same uncertainty displays, and v6 introduces no new uncertainty-reporting practice or statistical procedure.

E6.justification: v6 adds Llama-3 8B results in Table 2, including low-resource XCOPA scores of 56.9 for ShifCon, 55.1 for MSFT, and 56.0 for AFP. Table 10 adds mean-pooling control scores, and Table 18 adds Llama-3's [11, 20] layer area. Previously reported numerical results are retained.

T1.justification: Equations 1–8, the subspace/SVD construction, and the language-vector update derivation are retained. Explicit tensor dimensions clarify existing quantities, and added attribution clarifies provenance; neither introduces new mathematical reasoning, assumptions, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, contributions, and conclusion retain the claims about improving non-dominant languages, particularly low-resource languages, through shifting and contrastive alignment. Claims about layer selection and generalization across models are unchanged. Adding 'Multilingual' to the framework name clarifies its existing scope.

C2.justification: Section 3.3 newly attributes Llama-3's smaller gains to stronger initial multilingual capabilities while identifying remaining low-resource performance gaps. Section 6 updates the tested-model limit from 7.5B to 8B. Existing mechanism explanations and parallel-data and architecture limitations remain.

D1.justification: v6 clarifies representation dimensions and adds Llama-3 architecture and shift-layer information. It removes v5's future code-release statement and repository URL without replacement. This changes access documentation; actual repository availability cannot be inferred from the PDFs.

R1.justification: v6 adds references including Llama 3, Kholodna et al., Libovický et al., Wang et al., and GuiloMo, and removes the PolyLM reference. It explicitly credits Chang et al. for LDA and the language-subspace definition. These are limited attribution and citation changes within the retained research positioning.

P1.justification: v6 adds 'Multilingual' to the title, edits author and affiliation text, clarifies notation and wording, and gives the existing pooling study and language-vector strategy separate appendix subsections. The main narrative and section sequence remain substantially intact.

P2.justification: v6 adds Table 10, expands the model-related tables, moves the pooling table, and boxes Findings 1–6. Retained figures are resized or repositioned, and appendix visualization captions gain attribution. All eleven figures retain their underlying graphical content.

improvement.justification: The added Llama-3 evaluation in Table 2 and targeted language-vector ablation in Table 10 modestly strengthen evidence for generalization and an existing design choice. Clearer attribution and appendix organization also help. Removing the prospective code link weakens access guidance, but this limited loss does not outweigh the added validation; v5 did not establish that code had been released.
